policy: Official Toyota U.S. retail, full-spec, comparison, brochure and Toyota USA Newsroom sources only. Missing/non-applicable values are explicitly labelled and never guessed. Gallery assets use Toyota retail AEM imagery and must pass the repository gallery-health audit before production readiness.

bZ Woodland.powertrain: Battery-electric SUV with dual electric motors and standard electronic AWD with X-MODE and Grip Control
bZ Woodland.cargo: Up to 74.3 cu ft of rear cargo area with the second-row seats folded flat
bZ Woodland.technology: 14-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen, dual Qi wireless charging, four USB-C ports, NACS charging port and 11-kW onboard charger; DC fast charging 10–80% in around 30 minutes under ideal conditions
bZ Woodland.safety: Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 standard, plus Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert, Safe Exit Alert and parking-assist features
bZ Woodland.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; EV driving components including traction battery 8 years/100,000 miles
bZ Woodland.gallery_asset_note: Toyota states 2027 bZ Woodland features/specifications remain unchanged from 2026; official 2026 Toyota retail carryover imagery is used.

C-HR.powertrain: Battery-electric SUV with front and rear electric motors and standard electronic AWD
C-HR.dimensions: 177.9 in L × 73.6 in W × 63.8 in H; 108.3 in wheelbase
C-HR.cargo: 25.3 cu ft behind the rear seats; up to 59.5 cu ft with rear seats folded flat
C-HR.technology: 14-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen, dual Qi wireless charging, multiple USB-C ports, NACS charging port, 11-kW onboard AC charger and DC fast charging 10–80% in around 30 minutes under ideal conditions
C-HR.safety: Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 standard, plus Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and Safe Exit Alert
C-HR.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; EV driving components including traction battery 8 years/100,000 miles
C-HR.gallery_asset_note: Toyota states the 2027 C-HR is unchanged from 2026; official Toyota retail carryover imagery is used.

Prius Plug-in Hybrid.engine: 2.0L 4-cylinder plug-in hybrid engine with Toyota Hybrid System
Prius Plug-in Hybrid.efficiency: 2027 SE: EPA-estimated 51 MPG combined in hybrid mode and 128 MPGe combined
Prius Plug-in Hybrid.dimensions: Current-generation U.S. Prius Plug-in Hybrid: 181.1 in overall length, 70.1–70.2 in width and 55.9–56.3 in height by grade; 108.3 in wheelbase
Prius Plug-in Hybrid.cargo: 20.3 cu ft EPA-estimated cargo volume with rear seats up
Prius Plug-in Hybrid.technology: Available 12.3-in Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen, wireless smartphone integration, available Advanced Park and Traffic Jam Assist
Prius Plug-in Hybrid.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; hybrid components 8 years/100,000 miles and hybrid battery 10 years/150,000 miles

RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.engine: 2.5L inline 4-cylinder plug-in hybrid powertrain with electric motors and standard AWD
RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.efficiency: 2026 SE: up to about 40 MPG combined in hybrid mode and 102 MPGe combined on Toyota's current retail listing
RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.dimensions: 182.0 in L × 74.0 in W × 66.0 in H; 106.0 in wheelbase
RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.cargo: 33.6 cu ft cargo capacity behind the rear seat on the referenced U.S. configuration
RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.technology: Toyota Audio Multimedia with available 12.9-in touchscreen, 12.3-in digital gauge cluster and available Advanced Park/connected features
RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid.warranty: 36 months/36,000 miles basic; 60 months/60,000 miles powertrain; Toyota hybrid component and traction-battery warranties apply

Sienna.efficiency: EPA-estimated up to 36 city / 36 highway / 36 combined MPG on the referenced U.S. configuration
